body:
When shared-cookie sync adopts a login popup's tokens before its `post_auth` message arrives, the embedded opener's matching-token shortcut returns without navigating. The child can remain on `/login` with its protected event still pending. Complete the validated return redirect when the matching tokens are valid, allowing the destination's page-load guard to replay the action once while avoiding redundant token writes and audit emissions.

Adds unit coverage for matching tokens with and without refresh tokens, rejected tokens, and redirect validation; browser coverage checks normal login and a deterministic cookie-before-message ordering, automatic child navigation, one replay, and pending storage cleanup. Cookie-handler registration is reset between temporary test apps. Includes a bugfix changelog fragment.

Fixes #253.

Validation:
- Auth unit tests: 501 passed, 2 skipped on Reflex 0.9.12; 502 passed, 1 skipped on the newer Reflex API.
- Browser matrix: 6 passed on each environment, covering default scopes and `offline_access`. The deterministic pending-replay case fails against the original source.
- All commit hooks passed: Ruff formatting/lint, codespell, stub generation, and Pyright.
title: fix: complete iframe popup login after cookie sync
head: codex/fix-iframe-popup-replay
